info.title: Elmo API
info.description:
Track how AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews mention and cite your brands. Manage the brands, prompts, and competitors Elmo tracks, and pull the visibility and citation analytics behind the dashboard.

## Authentication

Every request carries a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header. Two kinds of token are accepted.

**Instance admin keys** come from the operator's `ADMIN_API_KEYS` environment variable. They reach every organization and every endpoint, including the admin-only ones, and are not subject to plan limits or rate limits.

**Organization keys** (`elmo_…`) are issued from the dashboard. A key acts inside exactly one organization, is issued either read or read-write access, and may be narrowed further to a subset of that organization's brands. Plan limits, read-only mode, and per-key rate limits all apply.

## Scopes

A key holds one of two scopes. `read` reaches every read operation; `write` adds every create, update, and delete one, and is issued alongside `read` rather than instead of it. Each operation lists what it requires in `x-elmo-scopes` — an operation listing none is reachable by any valid key. Admin keys hold both implicitly.

| Scope | Grants |
| --- | --- |
| `read` | Read brands, prompts, competitors, runs, citations, analytics, and the organization's plan and usage |
| `write` | Everything `read` grants, plus creating, updating, and deleting brands, prompts, and competitors |

Nothing finer is offered, because the operations actually worth withholding are not ones a scope can withhold. Deleting a *prompt* has no scope at all: it takes every run and citation with it, the dashboard offers no such action, and `PATCH /prompts/{promptId}` with `enabled: false` stops the tracking without losing the history. It is reachable with an instance admin key only.

There is deliberately no billing write scope: the API cannot change a subscription, an add-on quantity, or a payment method under any key, including an admin key. Operations marked `x-elmo-admin-only` are reachable with an instance admin key only; no scope grants them. Report generation and brand analysis spend provider budget with no organization to bill it to; deleting a prompt destroys tracked history the dashboard itself will not. For the same reason a single *field* can be admin-only: `enabled` on `PATCH /brands/{brandId}` stops a brand being sampled at all, so setting it with an organization key is a `403`.

## Access and errors

A brand outside the calling key's reach answers `404` with the same body a brand that does not exist would, so a key can never probe another tenant's data. A key that is valid but lacks the scope an operation requires answers `403` naming the missing scope.

Errors share one envelope — `{ error, message, code }` — where `code` is a stable machine-readable string. Treat an unrecognized `code` as its HTTP status implies; new values are added without a version bump.

## Conventions

Timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC; dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`. Collections take `page` (1-based) and `limit` (max 100) and answer with a `pagination` object. Analytics endpoints take `start` + `end` as ISO 8601 timestamps, half-open, and answer with the whole window in one response; daily series are labelled in UTC. `/prompts/{promptId}/snapshot` keeps the `startDate`/`endDate` calendar days it shipped with.

## Stability

An operation whose response shape may still change carries `x-stability: experimental`, and says so in the first line of its description. A schema can carry the same marker when only part of a stable operation's response is experimental. Everything else is stable: its shape will only ever gain fields. The absence of the marker is the promise.

BearerAuth.description: An instance admin key from `ADMIN_API_KEYS`, or an organization key (`elmo_…`) issued from the dashboard.

brandId.description: Brand identifier this prompt belongs to

enabled.description: Whether the prompt is currently enabled

tags.description: User-defined tags for categorizing this prompt

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the prompt was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the prompt was last updated

premiumModels.description: Models this prompt is tracked on grounded. Each entry spends one premium pairing.

brandId.description: Brand identifier this prompt belongs to

tags.description: User-defined tags for categorizing this prompt
User-defined tags for categorizing this prompt

premiumModels.description: Replaces the prompt's grounded models. Checked against the organization's premium pool.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Deliberately not an enum: new values are added without a version bump, so treat an unrecognized one as its HTTP status implies. Currently: `unauthorized`, `insufficient_scope`, `forbidden`, `not_found`, `validation_error`, `conflict`, `rate_limited`, `method_not_allowed`, `read_only`, `no_active_plan`, `brand_limit`, `prompt_limit`, `model_not_in_plan`, `model_picks_exceeded`, `premium_not_in_plan`, `premium_pool_exhausted`, `cadence_faster_than_plan`, `internal_error`.

brandAliases.description: Other names the brand goes by (spellings, abbreviations, product names). A mention of any of them counts as a brand mention.

brandWebsite.description: The brand's website — a domain (nike.com) or a full URL. A URL with a path (e.g. https://www.nike.com/golf) scopes the analysis to that page; mentions are tracked against its domain either way.

manualPrompts.description: Optional list of custom prompts to include in the report

brandAliases.description: Other names counted as brand mentions

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the report was created

ReportPromptSnapshot.description: Per-prompt snapshot of raw mention data from a report. Consumers compute SoV and other derived metrics.

promptValue.description: The prompt text that was evaluated

totalRuns.description: Number of evaluation runs for this prompt

MentionsSummary.description: Aggregated mention counts for a prompt across its evaluation runs.

mentionsTotal.description: Total brand + competitor mentions across all runs

brandMentionsTotal.description: Number of runs where the brand was mentioned

competitorMentionsTotal.description: Total count of individual competitor mentions across all runs (a single run mentioning 3 competitors counts as 3)

mentionsTopK.description: Top-K competitor entities ranked by mention count

count.description: Number of runs where this entity was mentioned
Number of times this URL was cited

website.description: Brand's website — a hostname or a full URL. A URL with a path (e.g. https://www.nike.com/golf) is analyzed as given; the returned website is always its domain.

brandName.description: Optional brand name hint. If omitted, inferred from the domain.

maxCompetitors.description: Maximum number of competitor suggestions. 0 disables competitor generation entirely.

maxPrompts.description: Maximum number of suggested prompts. 0 disables prompt generation entirely.

CreateBrandRequest.description: Create a brand. Skips onboarding. The first entry in `domains` is treated as the brand's primary website; the rest are stored as additional domains.

domains.description: Brand domains. The first entry is the primary website; remaining entries are additional domains.

organizationId.description:
Organization to create the brand in.

| | Omitted | Present |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Organization key** | creates in the key's own organization | must name the key's own organization; any other value is a `400` |
| **Admin key** | provisions a new organization named after the brand id | creates in the named organization, which must already exist — `404` if it does not |

An admin key omitting this field is currently the only way to create an organization over the API.

UpdateBrandRequest.description: Update brand-level fields. At least one field must be provided. Provided arrays replace the stored values verbatim. When `domains` is provided, the first entry becomes the primary website and the rest become additional domains. Prompts and competitors are managed via /prompts and /competitors.

domains.description: Brand domains. The first entry is the primary website; remaining entries are additional domains.

enabled.description: Whether the brand is sampled at all. **Modifiable only with an instance admin key**: setting it with an organization key is a `403`, because disabling ends tracking silently while the plan keeps being billed and no dashboard control does it at any role.

domains.description: Brand domains. The first entry is the primary website; remaining entries are additional domains.

organizationId.description: The organization that owns this brand and is billed for it.

enabledModels.description: Models this brand is tracked on. Null means the deployment default.

delayOverrideHours.description: Sampling cadence override in hours. Null means the plan cadence.

data.description: The items on this page. Read this rather than the named key below.

brands.description: Deprecated: read `data` instead. Kept while the one known consumer migrates, and removed in a future release.

data.description: The items on this page. Read this rather than the named key below.

competitors.description: Deprecated: read `data` instead. Kept while the one known consumer migrates, and removed in a future release.

CreateCompetitorRequest.description: Add a competitor to a brand.

UpdateCompetitorRequest.description: Update a competitor. At least one field must be provided. Provided arrays replace the stored values verbatim.

brandId.description: Brand identifier this prompt belongs to

startDate.description: Start of the queried date range (YYYY-MM-DD)

endDate.description: End of the queried date range (YYYY-MM-DD)

citationsTotal.description: Total number of citations across all runs

brandCitationsTotal.description: Number of citations to brand-owned domains

competitorCitationsTotal.description: Number of citations to competitor-owned domains

citedUrlsTopK.description: Top-K cited URLs ranked by frequency

DateRange.description: The window the response was computed over, echoed back as the half-open instants it resolved to.

keyType.description: `admin` for an instance key, `organization` for a dashboard-issued key.

organizationId.description: The organization this key acts inside. Null for admin keys.

scopes.description: Scopes this key holds. A read-write key lists both; an admin key always does.

brandIds.description: Brands the key is narrowed to, or null when it reaches every brand in its organization. Never an empty array — a restriction to no brands is rejected at creation rather than treated as no restriction.

expiresAt.description: When the key stops working, if it has an expiry.

rateLimit.description: The key's configured limit — generous by design: it exists to stop a runaway loop, not to meter normal use. Enforcement is a fixed window and approximate under concurrency.

createdBy.description: The key's label, as given when it was issued. Null for admin keys.

PlanLimits.description: The organization's plan limits. Every field is null on deployments without billing.

maxPrompts.description: Enabled prompts across the whole organization. Null means no limit.

modelMenu.description: Models the plan may pick from. Null means any.

OrganizationBilling.description: Read-only view of an organization's subscription, limits, and usage. The API has no way to change any of it: there is no billing write endpoint and no billing write scope. Stripe identifiers, payment methods, and invoices are deliberately not exposed — those live in the Stripe customer portal.

billingEnabled.description: False on self-hosted deployments, where nothing is metered.

plan.description: Null when the organization has no subscription, or when billing is disabled.

key.description: Plan identifier, or `custom` for a negotiated plan.

standing.description: What the subscription means for service, and the only field a caller needs to act on: `active` and `grace` keep tracking running, `paused` stops it, `none` is unsubscribed. The payment provider's own status string is deliberately not passed through.

interval.description: Null on a negotiated plan, which carries no billing interval.

trackingActive.description: Whether prompts are currently being sampled.

visibility.description: Null on days with no runs to plot; the series is not gap-filled with zeros. Ratio 0–1; multiply by 100 for a percentage.

Position.description:
**Experimental — the shape may still change.**

The company's position among the tracked companies the answers name, 1 being named first. Companies that aren't tracked aren't ranked. Counted over every answer in the window, unlike `visibility.current` and the share-of-voice `mentions` and `share`, which count each prompt's latest result.

average.description: Average position to one decimal; null when no answer ranks it.

isBrand.description: True for the tracked brand's own row.

prompts.description: Distinct prompts this entity appeared in.

share.description: This entity's share of all brand and competitor mentions. Ratio 0–1; multiply by 100 for a percentage.
The brand's share on this day. Null on days with no runs. Ratio 0–1; multiply by 100 for a percentage.

category.description: Which side of the citation landscape the domain sits on.

count.description: Citations to this domain in the window.

share.description: Share of all citations in the window. Ratio 0–1; multiply by 100 for a percentage.

promptCount.description: Distinct prompts whose answers cited this domain.

previousCount.description: Citations in the equal-length window immediately before this one.

changeFactor.description: How this window compares with the equal-length window before it, as a multiplier of the previous count: 2 means twice as many citations, 0.5 means half, 1 means unchanged. Not a percentage change — 1.5 is "1.5x", which is a 50% increase. Null when the domain had no citations in the previous window, so there is nothing to divide by.

data.description: This page of the domains cited over the window, ordered by citation count. `totals` covers every domain.

category.description: Which side of the citation landscape the domain sits on.

pageType.description: What kind of page was cited.

isNew.description: Not cited in the equal-length window immediately before this one.

data.description: This page of the URLs cited over the window, ordered by citation count. `totals` covers every URL.

query.description: A search the engine ran while answering.

fanoutRuns.description: Runs that searched at all. Engines that don't expose their searches contribute runs but no queries.

coverageRate.description: Share of fan-out query instances whose answer mentioned the brand. Ratio 0–1; multiply by 100 for a percentage.

data.description: This page of the distinct sub-queries over the window, ordered by the runs that ran them. The totals cover every query.

brandMentionRate.description: Share of this prompt's runs mentioning the brand. Ratio 0–1; multiply by 100 for a percentage.

competitorMentionRate.description: Share of this prompt's runs mentioning any tracked competitor. Ratio 0–1; multiply by 100 for a percentage.

data.description: Every prompt sampled over the window, with its results.

RunSummary.description: A single model answer, without its text. Fetch `GET /prompts/{promptId}/runs/{runId}` for the answer itself.

provider.description: How the answer was obtained. Informational; not a stable enum.

webSearchEnabled.description: Whether the engine answered with its own web search on.

webQueries.description: Searches the engine ran, where it exposes them.

citationIndex.description: Position within the answer's citation list.

Run.description: One model answer with its normalized text and citations.

text.description: The answer, normalized out of the provider's response. Null when nothing could be extracted.

name.description: The tag, normalized to lower case.

promptCount.description: Prompts in this brand carrying the tag.

system.description: True for `branded` and `unbranded`, which Elmo computes from the prompt text. A system tag always appears here; applying it to a prompt as a user tag overrides the computed classification rather than creating a new tag.

data.description: System tags first, then user tags alphabetically — the order the dashboard's filter shows.

text.description: The prompt as the report names it.

promptId.description: The tracked prompt it resolved to, or null when it didn't match one.

category.description: Which workstream this belongs to: `creation` is net-new content, `existing-content` is a page that could win the mention with a refresh, `outreach` is earning a placement on a third-party site assistants cite, `social` is the community conversations they pull from.

title.description: Short and action-oriented — the concrete surface or angle.

why.description: Why it is worth doing, in plain language.

relatedPrompts.description: Tracked prompts this would help. May be empty.

yourCitations.description: Pages on the brand's own domains already cited for those prompts.

competitorCitations.description: Pages on competitor domains cited for those prompts.

BrandOpportunities.description: The brand's latest Opportunities report — the same LLM-generated analysis the dashboard shows, read from the append-only history rather than regenerated. Elmo decides when to produce a new one; there is no way to trigger generation over the API, because it spends provider budget with no per-call metering behind it.

status.description: `ready` when a report is present. `insufficient-data` when the brand hasn't accumulated enough tracked answers to say anything useful yet, in which case the lists are empty.

model.description: The model that produced the report, when recorded.

summary.description: A few bullets on where the brand stands and the through-line of the plan.

risks.description: Caveats: hard-to-win areas, or tactics to avoid.

visibility.description: Share of this model's runs that mentioned the brand. Ratio 0–1; multiply by 100 for a percentage.

BrandAnalytics.description: Every non-paginated figure for a brand over one window. There is no parameter for selecting a subset: the computations behind this cover the same prompts and run concurrently, so a subset would save a caller a fraction of one request and cost everyone a parameter to reason about.

visibility.description: How often the brand is mentioned at all.

current.description: The last plotted point — the number the dashboard hero shows. Ratio 0–1; multiply by 100 for a percentage.

shareOfVoice.description: The brand against its tracked competitors.

brand.description: The brand's own share at the end of the window. Ratio 0–1; multiply by 100 for a percentage.

models.description: Per-model visibility and run counts. Only models that produced a run in the window appear.

prompts.description: Enabled prompts counted in the window.

id.description: Identifier used by the `model` filter, e.g. `chatgpt`.

premiumCapable.description: Whether this model can be tracked grounded, spending a premium pairing.

configured.description: Whether this deployment is actually wired to reach it.

MentionAssessment.description:
**Experimental — the shape may still change.**

The mention judge's assessment of one brand or competitor named in an answer.

mentioned.description: Whether the answer counts as mentioning this company. A name the judge can't call either way counts.

probability.description: Calibrated probability that the answer mentions this company.

reason.description: When it isn't counted as a mention, the likeliest other reading: `other_meaning` (the name used as an ordinary word), `other_company` (a different company with the same name) or `no_info` (the answer says it knows nothing about it). Informational; not a stable enum.

sentiment.description: The likeliest sentiment toward this company in the passages about it. Null when the answer isn't about it, or when it only links to the company.

sentimentProbabilities.description: Probability of each sentiment, keyed by label.

position.description: 1 for the tracked company the answer names first, 2 for the next, and so on. Null when the answer isn't counted as mentioning it.

mentionCount.description: How many times the answer mentions it. Null when the answer isn't counted as mentioning it.

RunAssessments.description:
**Experimental — the shape may still change.**

The mention judge's assessments for one answer. Null when the run's mentions were matched by name, before the judge, until a replay judges it.

brand.description: Null when the answer never names the brand.

competitors.description: Keyed by competitor name; only competitors the answer names.

SentimentSummary.description:
**Experimental — the shape may still change.**

Answers that mention the company, by the mention judge's sentiment toward it. An answer that only links to the company counts in none. All zero for history the judge hasn't re-judged yet. Counted over every answer in the window, unlike `visibility.current` and the share-of-voice `mentions` and `share`, which count each prompt's latest result.

score.description: Net sentiment of the answers with a sentiment: positive counts 1, neutral and mixed 0.5, negative 0, averaged. 0.5 means neutral on balance. Ratio 0–1; null when there are none.

BrandSentiment.description:
**Experimental — the shape may still change.**

The brand's sentiment over the window, with the counts for each day so a client can chart or smooth them.

BrandPosition.description:
**Experimental — the shape may still change.**

The brand's position among the tracked companies the answers name, 1 being named first, averaged over the window and per day.

average.description: Average position over the window, to one decimal; null when no answer ranks it.

GeoFactStatus.description: 品牌和产品上表示客户确认状态；UNVERIFIED 即“待客户确认”。

domains.description: 主机名；URL 会被归一为主机名，www 与裸域视为同一站点。

factNotes.description: 待客户确认的事实，每条一句。

changeNote.description: 写入词典版本的变更说明。

GeoBrandPatch.description: 省略的字段保持不变；null 清空可空字段。名称、别名或域名与其他启用实体冲突时返回 CONFLICT。

termKind.description: GENERIC 为通用产品词，不能带型号；CUSTOMER_MODEL 为客户型号，必须带型号。

history.description: 别名与字段变更历史，按词典版本倒序。

snapshot.description: 该版本的完整品牌、竞品与产品词典，不可变。

tier.description: EXTENDED 默认不进入高频监测。

ownerId.description: 组织成员的用户 ID；省略时为创建人。

GeoPromptPatch.description: 只有 DRAFT 可编辑；每次保存生成新修订。

latestFrozenSet.description: test_set_version：最近一次包含该问法的冻结测试集。

action.description: SUBMIT 草稿→业务审核（需填齐角色、意图、产品线、地区）；APPROVE 审核→入选基线；REJECT 审核→驳回（需 comment）；REVISE 驳回/基线/冻结→草稿。APPROVE、REJECT 需要 `prompt.review`，API Key 不具备；作者、负责人和编辑过该问法的人不能审核。

GeoFrozenPromptSet.description: 冻结后的不可变快照；监测轮次只使用 questionText。

GeoSamplingTarget.description: 能力矩阵中的一个采样目标。不包含凭据，只返回是否已设置。

runnable.description: 已启用、已验证（PASSED/LIMITED）、配置完整且部署允许，可加入采样批次

promptSetId.description: 必须是已冻结的问法集

idempotencyKey.description: 同一 key 返回已创建的批次；也可用 Idempotency-Key 请求头

plannedCount.description: 计划样本数（问法 × 目标 × 重复次数），重采不增加

GeoManualImportRow.description: question 与 promptId 至少一个

sampledAt.description: ISO 8601，或 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm（按北京时间）

evidenceLocation.description: http(s) 链接、上传接口返回的 upload:<sha256>.<ext>，或存档说明

row.description: 从 1 开始；0 表示整个文件

skipped.description: 与已有证据完全相同而跳过的行数

countsInRates.description: 只有 VALID 计入比率分母

GeoObservation.description: 不可变的证据记录，含引用、采样尝试与全部评估版本

sourceRef.description: 非 MANUAL 时必填；同一来源已有未结束工单时返回该工单

evidence.description: 非 MANUAL 时至少一条，否则 EVIDENCE_REQUIRED

ownerId.description: ASSIGN 必填（或工单已有责任人）

publishedAt.description: PUBLISH 必填，不晚于当前时间、不早于工单创建时间

afterBatchId.description: VERIFY 需要前后批次：同一问法集、均已完成、复测批次在发布后创建

comparison.description: 基线批次与复测批次按相同条件对比，口径与 `GET /geo/metrics/batch-comparison` 相同。未关联两个批次、调用者没有 GEO 权限 `metric.read`，或两个批次不属于同一问法集版本时为 null。

GeoSiteProfile.description: 版本化的站点规则：范围、分页、栏目、字段选择器、附件、高风险字段与告警阈值。

keyUrls.description: 客户确认的重点网址清单

crawlCron.description: 空值表示默认 0 3 * * *（每 24 小时）

urls.description: 只抓取这些网址（须在白名单内），不跟随链接

meta.description: robots.txt 结果、站点地图、范围外链接样例等

jobId.description: pg-boss 作业 id；已有同名作业排队时为 null

parsed.description: 标题、正文、表格、图片、字段及其定位

versionId.description: 省略时用最新版本的原始 HTML

profileVersion.description: 省略时用当前解析配置

oneOf.description: 保密资料对无 `knowledge.read_confidential` 的调用方只返回存在性（hidden=true）

evidenceClass.description: 已审核事实与未审核网页/资料内容严格区分

publicationScope.description: APPROVE 必填，且不能宽于来源允许的范围

validUntil.description: YYYY-MM-DD（按东八区当日结束）或 ISO 时间
YYYY-MM-DD（按东八区当日结束）或 ISO 时间

entity.description: 已有实体 id，或按种类+名称归并/新建（与官网实体同一规范化键）

locator.description: 页码、段落、章节至少填一项

validUntil.description: YYYY-MM-DD（按东八区当日结束）或 ISO 时间

locator.description: 页码、段落、章节至少填一项

assertionIds.description: 只接受 APPROVED、PUBLIC、在有效期内、未冻结且无冲突的断言；按顺序编号为 F1..Fn

mode.description: LLM 需组织已批准调用大模型，否则 403

body.description: MANUAL 必填；事实句末以 [F1] 标注来源

GeoInsights.description: meta（时间窗口、问法集版本、采样方式、有效样本量、更新时间、口径与评估规则版本）与 insights（cells 按平台×采样方式、trends 含断点、prompts 问题矩阵、gaps 缺口、overview 等权概览）。

GeoBatchComparisonRow.description: 同一平台与采样方式的两轮结果，只统计两轮都采样过的问法，重采样按计划位次去重，每个位次只计一条样本。

mentionDelta.description: 百分点；任一轮无数据时为 null。

recommendationDelta.description: 百分点；任一轮无数据时为 null。

conditionChanges.description: 两轮之间仍不一致的条件；非空时对比不可靠。

GeoReportCreate.description: month 与 from/to 二选一。

snapshot.description: format elmo-geo-report/1：方法、样本、指标、趋势、发现、已执行任务、业务输入量、中间结果、业务结果说明、未完成风险、下期计划、证据链接与所用评估版本

items.description: 版本、evaluator_version、词典版本、结论、evidence_spans、confidence、review_status、review_reasons、is_current、supersedes_id、操作人与依据
抽取的数字/型号/证书断言、与已审核知识的比对结果和技术审核结论

evidence.description: 规则相关的证据；summary 为一句话说明，url/title/category 来自被审计的页面版本

pageVersionId.description: 证据快照所在的页面版本

priority.description: 不填时取所选发现中最高的优先级

site.description: robots.txt、站点地图与 HTTPS 的检查结果（超时与证书错误分别记录）

ForbiddenError.description: The key is valid but not permitted: a missing scope, an admin-only endpoint, or a write in read-only (demo) mode.

PaymentRequiredError.description: The organization has no active subscription. Cloud deployments only.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Items per page. Values above the maximum are clamped, not rejected.

WindowStart.name: start
WindowStart.description: Inclusive lower bound of the window, an ISO 8601 timestamp such as `2026-01-01T00:00:00Z`. Aligned down to the quarter hour, the grain analytics are aggregated at; where a response repeats the window, it repeats the aligned one. **Experimental — the response shape may still change.**

The brand's Opportunities report: a prioritized set of ways to get cited more often, with the tracked prompts and cited pages behind each one. The same analysis the dashboard shows, from the same code.

Generation is inline and synchronous. A stored report is served while it is fresh and regenerated when it is not, so there is nothing to poll for and no way to be handed a stale one — but a request that triggers a generation waits for it. The freshness window bounds the cost: however many callers ask, one generation per brand per window. There is deliberately no `POST`, which would spend provider budget with nothing metering it per call.

get.description: 需要 GEO 权限 `site_audit.read`。同一规则同一页面跨运行只有一条发现；复跑审计未再发现的自动转为 RESOLVED。“可被抓取”与“被 AI 检索、引用或推荐”不是同一指标；接口只返回诊断与建议，不修改官网。

get.description: 需要 GEO 权限 `site_audit.read`。evidence 中的 pageVersionId 指向站点页面版本，可经 `/geo/site-pages/{pageId}/versions/{versionId}/snapshot` 查看原始快照（需 `site.read_snapshot`）。

patch.summary: 更新发现状态、优先级、责任部门、目标问法或建议
patch.description: 需要 GEO 权限 `site_audit.triage`。人工只能把 OPEN 改为 DISMISSED（必须填写 note）或把 DISMISSED 恢复为 OPEN；TASKED 由建单产生，RESOLVED 由复跑审计判定。每次修改写审计日志。

post.summary: 从发现批量创建优化工单
post.description: 需要 GEO 权限 `task.create`。只为 OPEN 的发现建单，其他状态跳过并在 skipped 中返回。PER_PAGE 时同一页面已有未结束工单则并入该工单；建单后发现转为 TASKED 并关联 task_id。

post.description: 需要 GEO 权限 `site_audit.run`。只建任务、不同步执行，返回 job id。审计读取已采集的页面版本，不重新抓取页面；robots.txt、站点地图与 HTTPS 检查走与采集相同的白名单、限速和熔断。同一站点已有排队或进行中的审计时返回该审计（200）；站点 24 小时内最多 24 次（RATE_LIMITED）。官网采集成功结束后会自动入队一次。
